name: Fungal Spores
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery.  Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.

Invigorating, and altering.

There is a mushroom that grows near these oases.  Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.

Bring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
narrative.objectives: Bring 4 Fungal Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, yes. These are good specimens. Potent.

I am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts. Here is your reward, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the spores, adventurer? There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
